sentences.cn_text: 围绕人工智能在数字营销中的应用已经开展了一些探索。
sentences.en_text: There has been some exploration around the use of AI in digital marketing.

sentences.cn_text: 例如，人工智能可以通过分析大数据来揭示趋势和偏好信息，从而分析哪种类型的广告内容或文案适合与特定目标客户群体「对话」。
sentences.en_text: For example, AI can be used to analyse what type of advertising content or copy would be appropriate to ‘speak’ to a specific target customer group by revealing information about trends and preferences through the analysis of big data.

sentences.cn_text: 人工智能还可以用于识别客户在爱好、喜爱的名人、音乐选择和时尚方面的生活方式选择，从而在通过社交媒体发布的营销信息中提供独特的内容。
sentences.en_text: AI can also be used to identify the lifestyle choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities, music choices, and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through social media.

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时，人工智能还可以用于为社交媒体帖子和聊天网站生成内容。
sentences.en_text: At the same time AI can also be used to generate content for social media posts and chat sites.

sentences.cn_text: 人工智能还可以在品牌与客户进行情感沟通的需求和识别客户快速变化的需求之间搭建桥梁。
sentences.en_text: AI can also provide a bridge between the need of the brand to communicate emotionally with the customer and identifying their rapidly changing needs.

sentences.cn_text: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点在于，人们对将个人互动托付给机器存在信任方面的担忧，这不仅可能导致人际联系的随之丧失，还可能导致营销人员的减少。
sentences.en_text: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.

sentences.cn_text: 一些人认为，人工智能通过降低创造力和减少工作岗位，对营销人员的角色产生了负面影响，但他们也意识到这是一种降低成本和创造新信息的方式。
sentences.en_text: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer’s role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.

sentences.cn_text: 通过让人工智能开发内容，一些品牌营销人员可能会发现他们正在失去对品牌叙事的控制。
sentences.en_text: By allowing AI to develop content some brand marketers may find that they are losing control over the brand narrative.

sentences.cn_text: 用于模拟人类互动的算法正在引发许多此类担忧,尤其是因为没有人完全确定使用人工智能与客户互动的结果将会如何。
sentences.en_text: Algorithms that are used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns, especially as no-one is quite sure what the outcomes of using AI to interact with customers will be.

sentences.cn_text: 要让人工智能取得成功，数据需要是可访问的，但个人数据的使用正变得更加受到监管，数据的自动共享也变得更加困难。
sentences.en_text: For AI to be successful, data needs to be accessible, but the use of personal data is becoming more regulated and the automated sharing of data is becoming more difficult.

sentences.cn_text: 如果客户不愿意共享数据，人工智能将缺乏必要的信息，无法有效运作或利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
sentences.en_text: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.

sentences.cn_text: 因此，除非客户愿意签署授权协议，否则人工智能的使用在未来可能会受到某种程度的限制。
sentences.en_text: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.

sentences.cn_text: 人工智能不仅可以帮助创建营销内容，还可以提供一种非侵扰性的方式将内容传递给目标客户。
sentences.en_text: Not only can AI help to create the marketing content, but it can also provide a non-intrusive way of delivering the content to the target customers.

sentences.cn_text: 可以收集关于客户可以被触达的位置的数据，例如地理位置、使用的设备、网站互动和访问过的网站，以便以适当的形式和适当的频率展示营销信息，包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹出式广告和横幅广告。
sentences.en_text: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location, devices used, website interactions, and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.

sentences.cn_text: 以一种对目标客户需求敏感的方式非侵扰性地传递营销信息，是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。
sentences.en_text: The non-intrusive delivery of the marketing messages in a way that is sensitive to the needs of the target customer is one of the critical challenges to the digital marketer.

sentences.cn_text: 理解人类可能很复杂，但我们通过浏览历史揭示了大量关于什么能吸引我们的信息。
sentences.en_text: Understanding humans may be complicated, but we reveal a considerable amount about what appeals to us through our browsing history.
